name: What are some popular features for modern custom pools?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular features for modern custom pools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern custom pools often integrate a variety of features to enhance aesthetics and functionality. Popular additions include infinity edges (negative edges) that create a vanishing water effect, integrated spas with hydrotherapy jets, LED lighting for ambiance and safety, and automated control systems for water chemistry, heating, and lighting. Other sought-after elements include sun shelves (baja shelves), custom water features like sheer descents or waterfalls, and energy-efficient equipment like variable-speed pumps and solar heating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular modern pool features include infinity edges, integrated spas, LED lighting, automation systems, sun shelves, and various water features.
